name: 毛泽东
title: 伟大的无产阶级革命家、战略家和理论家
titleEn: Great Proletarian Revolutionary, Strategist and Theoretician
description: 中国共产党、中国人民解放军和中华人民共和国的主要缔造者和领导人，诗人，书法家。
descriptionEn: Principal founder of the CPC, the PPLA and the PRC. Poet and calligrapher.

quotes.text: 为人民服务
quotes.textEn: Serve the People
quotes.sourceEn: "Serve the People" (1944)

quotes.text: 人民，只有人民，才是创造世界历史的动力。
quotes.textEn: The people, and the people alone, are the motive force in the making of world history.
quotes.sourceEn: "On Coalition Government" (1945)

quotes.text: 枪杆子里面出政权。
quotes.textEn: Political power grows out of the barrel of a gun.
quotes.sourceEn: Speech at the Emergency Meeting of the CPC (1927)

quotes.text: 星星之火，可以燎原。
quotes.textEn: A single spark can start a prairie fire.
quotes.sourceEn: "A Single Spark Can Start a Prairie Fire" (1930)

quotes.text: 枪杆子里面出政权。
quotes.textEn: Political power grows out of the barrel of a gun.
quotes.sourceEn: Speech at the Emergency Meeting of the CPC (1927)

quotes.text: 自己动手，丰衣足食。
quotes.textEn: Use your own hands, you'll have ample food and clothing.
quotes.sourceEn: Inscription for the Great Production Movement (1943)

quotes.text: 好好学习，天天向上。
quotes.textEn: Study hard and make progress every day.
quotes.sourceEn: Inscription for children (1951)

quotes.text: 世界是你们的，也是我们的，但是归根结底是你们的。
quotes.textEn: The world is yours, as well as ours, but in the last analysis, it is yours.
quotes.sourceEn: Speech to Chinese students in Moscow (1957)

quotes.text: 一切反动派都是纸老虎。
quotes.textEn: All reactionaries are paper tigers.
quotes.source: 和美国记者安娜·路易斯·斯特朗的谈话 1946年
quotes.sourceEn: Interview with American journalist Anna Louise Strong (1946)

quotes.text: 人不犯我，我不犯人；人若犯我，我必犯人。
quotes.textEn: We will not attack unless we are attacked; if we are attacked, we will certainly counterattack.
quotes.source: 《目前抗日统一战线中的策略问题》1940年
quotes.sourceEn: "On the Question of the United Front Against Japan" (1940)

quotes.text: 下定决心，不怕牺牲，排除万难，去争取胜利。
quotes.textEn: Be resolute, fear no sacrifice, and surmount every difficulty to win victory.
quotes.sourceEn: "The Foolish Old Man Who Removed the Mountains" (1945)

quotes.text: 领导我们事业的核心力量是中国共产党，指导我们思想的理论基础是马克思列宁主义。
quotes.textEn: The force at the core leading our cause forward is the Chinese Communist Party. The theoretical basis guiding our thinking is Marxism-Leninism.
quotes.source: 第一届全国人民代表大会开幕词 1954年
quotes.sourceEn: Opening address at the First Session of the First National People's Congress (1954)

quotes.text: 我们都是来自五湖四海，为了一个共同的革命目标，走到一起来了。
quotes.textEn: We hail from all corners of the country and have joined together for a common revolutionary objective.
quotes.sourceEn: "Serve the People" (1944)

quotes.text: 毫不利己，专门利人。
quotes.textEn: Be utterly devoted to others without any selfishness.
quotes.sourceEn: "In Memory of Norman Bethune" (1939)

quotes.text: 学习的敌人是自己的满足，要认真学习一点东西，必须从不自满开始。
quotes.textEn: The enemy of learning is self-satisfaction. To really learn something, one must start by not being self-satisfied.
quotes.source: 《中国共产党在民族战争中的地位》1938年
quotes.sourceEn: "The Role of the Chinese Communist Party in the National War" (1938)

quotes.text: 一万年太久，只争朝夕。
quotes.textEn: Ten thousand years are too long. Seize the day, seize the hour.
quotes.sourceEn: "Man Jiang Hong: A Reply to Comrade Guo Moruo" (1963)

quotes.text: 数风流人物，还看今朝。
quotes.textEn: For truly great men, look to this age alone.
quotes.sourceEn: "Snow: To the Tune of Qin Yuan Chun" (1936)

quotes.text: 问苍茫大地，谁主沉浮？
quotes.textEn: I ask the vast earth, who rules over destiny?
quotes.sourceEn: "Changsha: To the Tune of Qin Yuan Chun" (1925)

quotes.text: 雄关漫道真如铁，而今迈步从头越。
quotes.textEn: The strong pass is truly like iron, yet now with firm strides we are crossing its summit.
quotes.sourceEn: "Loushan Pass: To the Tune of Qin E" (1935)

quotes.text: 恰同学少年，风华正茂；书生意气，挥斥方遒。
quotes.textEn: With our classmates, in the prime of youth, full of scholarly vigor, we spoke with passionate eloquence.
quotes.sourceEn: "Changsha: To the Tune of Qin Yuan Chun" (1925)

quotes.text: 宜将剩勇追穷寇，不可沽名学霸王。
quotes.textEn: With our remaining courage we should pursue the cornered enemy. We must not seek fame like the Hegemon-King.
quotes.source: 《七律·人民解放军占领南京》1949年
quotes.sourceEn: "The PLA Captures Nanjing" (1949)

quotes.text: 天若有情天亦老，人间正道是沧桑。
quotes.textEn: Were nature sentient, she too would pass from youth to age. The only way forward for mankind is through revolution.
quotes.source: 《七律·人民解放军占领南京》1949年
quotes.sourceEn: "The PLA Captures Nanjing" (1949)

quotes.text: 世上无难事，只要肯登攀。
quotes.textEn: Nothing is difficult in this world if you dare to scale the heights.
quotes.sourceEn: "Reascending Jinggangshan" (1965)

quotes.text: 与天奋斗，其乐无穷；与地奋斗，其乐无穷；与人奋斗，其乐无穷。
quotes.textEn: To struggle with Heaven is an endless joy; to struggle with Earth is an endless joy; to struggle with people is an endless joy.
quotes.sourceEn: Early diary (1917)
